events.title: Emperor Suzaku abdicates in favour of his brother Murakami
events.description: Emperor Suzaku, the 61st emperor of Japan in the traditional order of succession, abdicated in the 16th year of his reign. His younger brother Nariakira received the succession as Emperor Murakami, the 62nd emperor.
events.html: Emperor Suzaku, the 61st emperor of Japan in the traditional order of succession, abdicated in the 16th year of his reign. His younger brother Nariakira received the succession as Emperor Murakami, the 62nd emperor.

events.title: Mahmud of Ghazni defeats the Samanid army near Merv
events.description: Ghaznavid forces under Mahmud of Ghazni and his brother Abu'l Muzaffar Nasr, with cavalry and elephants, defeated the Samanid army of Abd al-Malik II near Merv. The Samanid dynasty collapsed soon after, with the Kara-Khanid invasion of Bukhara.

events.title: Baldwin I is crowned first emperor of the Latin Empire
events.description: Baldwin, Count of Flanders and a leader of the Fourth Crusade, was crowned in Hagia Sophia as the first emperor of the Latin Empire. In 1205 the Bulgarian tsar Kaloyan defeated and captured him at Adrianople.
events.html: Baldwin, Count of Flanders and a leader of the Fourth Crusade, was crowned in Hagia Sophia as the first emperor of the Latin Empire. In 1205 the Bulgarian tsar Kaloyan defeated and captured him at Adrianople.

events.title: Bertrand du Guesclin defeats the Navarrese at Cocherel
events.description: In the Hundred Years' War, a French army under Bertrand du Guesclin defeated the Anglo-Navarrese army of King Charles II of Navarre, called the Bad, at Cocherel. The battle was fought over the succession to the Kingdom of France.
events.html: In the Hundred Years' War, a French army under Bertrand du Guesclin defeated the Anglo-Navarrese army of King Charles II of Navarre, called the Bad, at Cocherel. The battle was fought over the succession to the Kingdom of France.

events.title: Thomas More resigns as Lord Chancellor
events.description: A day after the clergy submitted to Henry VIII's authority, Sir Thomas More gave up the Great Seal. His refusal to accept the king's supremacy over the Church led to his execution in 1535.
events.html: A day after the clergy submitted to Henry VIII's authority, Sir Thomas More gave up the Great Seal. His refusal to accept the king's supremacy over the Church led to his execution in 1535.

events.title: Marie Antoinette marries the future Louis XVI
events.description: The fourteen-year-old Austrian archduchess married the French dauphin at Versailles, sealing an alliance between Habsburgs and Bourbons. Both were guillotined during the Revolution.
events.html: The fourteen-year-old Austrian archduchess married the French dauphin at Versailles, sealing an alliance between Habsburgs and Bourbons. Both were guillotined during the Revolution.

events.title: Andrew Johnson escapes conviction by one vote
events.description: The Senate voted 35 to 19 to convict President Johnson on the first article tried, one vote short of the two-thirds needed. Johnson was the first US president to be impeached.

events.title: First Academy Awards are presented in Hollywood
events.description: About 270 guests attended a dinner at the Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel where the first Oscars were handed out in around fifteen minutes. Wings won the top prize.
events.html: About 270 guests attended a dinner at the Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel where the first Oscars were handed out in around fifteen minutes. Wings won the top prize.

events.title: Theodore Maiman operates the first laser
events.description: At Hughes Research Laboratories in California, Maiman produced a pulse of red laser light from a ruby crystal. Lasers went on to transform medicine, communications and industry.
